notes.title: New functionality with Tobii Eye tracking
notes.content:
http://moondrop.no/files/amphora/amphora_eyex.gif

Today we have updated Amphora with support for Tobii EyeX! The game will react to your eyes for an enhanced gameplay experience. Eye tracking is available on some high-end laptops and as a standalone device you can use anywhere. You can read more about it following this link: http://www.tobii.com/xperience/

Only available for Windows at present time.

What eye tracking adds to Amphora

Extended View. Move the image on the screen simply by looking to the right or left.
Eye Adaptation. When you gaze at different places on the screen, light effects will automatically activate to highlight your focal point.
Affect Environment. Look at the butterflies that appear in each level to make them fly away. They will gather in the menu screen to show your progress.
Gaze Tracking. The mystical smoke that follows you throughout the game follows the movement of your eyes. Discover the important objects with your gaze.


http://moondrop.no/files/amphora/amphora_eyex_butterfly.gif

notes.title: Amphora now available on Mac! (Repost)
notes.content:
Note: The previous announcement was accidently deleted, we apologize for the inconvenience.

Today we are happy to announce that Amphora has been released for Mac. If you already have bought Amphora you will automatically have it available on both Windows and Mac. [strike]If you haven’t this is a good time as we are celebrating with a 25% discount![/strike] (Note: sale has ended)

We have also added Steam Trading Cards. When playing Amphora you will receive cards that you can craft into Badges, Backgrounds and Emoticons. 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/9131/amphora/steam/steamicons.png

Patch Notes (June 29 2015)

Amphora now available on Mac
Added Polish localization
Added trading cards and badges

notes.title: Amphora Update Released
notes.content:
An update to Amphora has been released!

We listened to a lot of your feedback and added better conveyance to some levels to make a better experience. We also fixed some bugs in the process.

Thanks for all your support and kind words.

Patch Notes (November 28 2014)

Bath Level - tweaked for a better experience
Sheep Level - puzzle changed slightly
Roast Level - puzzle changed slightly
Tide Level - added element for conveyance
Cliff Level - added element for conveyance
Increased physics iterations to make it more stable
Game will now run in offline mode
Many small bugs fixed
